items.statement: The investigation validates separate neutral HL and singly azomethine-N-protonated HL states before comparing orbitals.
items.expected: State identity, charge, multiplicity, convergence/stationarity and orbital assignment are all documented.

items.statement: The investigation uses a consistent, reproducible comparison of HOMO/LUMO energies and gaps for both states.
items.expected: Both gaps are in eV, calculated from explicitly identified frontier levels, with a reported comparison and coverage/limitations.

items.statement: The protonated state has a smaller frontier gap than neutral HL in the source-backed comparison.
items.expected: The submitted result reports and supports a decrease on protonation.

items.statement: The frontier-density redistribution is used cautiously as evidence relevant to acid-induced spectral change.
items.expected: The interpretation is explicitly bounded as qualitative ground-state support, not proof of an absorption wavelength or unique mechanism.
